script.text: In 1881, this painting sold for two guilders and thirty cents.
script.say: In eighteen eighty-one, this painting sold for two guilders and thirty cents.

script.text: It was so dirty, almost nobody knew what it was.
Johannes Vermeer painted it around 1665, in his home town of Delft.
script.say: Yohannes Vermeer painted it around sixteen sixty-five, in his home town of Delft.

script.text: And she is nobody: not a portrait, but a tronie, an imaginary face.
script.say: And she is nobody: not a portrait, but a troh-nee, an imaginary face.

script.text: Look at the blue of her turban.
It was ground from lapis lazuli, a stone carried all the way from Afghanistan.
Now look at the pearl. It has no hook, and no loop. Just a few touches of white paint.
Behind her there was once a green curtain, now faded into the dark.
We still do not know who she was. But she is still looking back.

post.caption: Bought for two guilders and thirty cents. Painted with a stone from Afghanistan. And the pearl? Look closer.
